definitions.explanation: A large-scale festival or ceremonial event, often of religious, cultural, or commemorative significance. More formal than 祭り, emphasizing the ceremonial or official nature of the event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祭典|さいてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{祭典|さいてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|おごそ}か→厳か：11864_ogosoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A ceremony was solemnly performed at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創立記念|そうりつきねん}{祭典|さいてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Many citizens participated in the city's founding anniversary ceremony.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
{祭典|さいてん} is more formal and ceremonial than ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧, which is the everyday word for festival. {祭典|さいてん} often implies an official or large-scale event with ritual significance, while ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧ can refer to any festive occasion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧{祭典|さいてん}: commemorative ceremony
- ⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧{祭典|さいてん}: religious ceremony
- {祭典|さいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}う→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧: to hold/conduct a ceremony
